Maya (CS): Morning — quick intake huddle for NimbusEdge onboarding. Goal: nail down success criteria, ownership, and a tight 30-day timeline. @Jake can you confirm who will own the infra work?
Jake (Solutions Eng): I can take lead on infra. Need customer's S3 + inbound IP for upload, and a rough expected QPS for burst sizing. Also will schedule an install window.
Sophie (PM): Draft success metrics from our side: 90% of core flows passing smoke tests, <200ms median latency on the test corpus, and single-digit escalation rate from their L1 during week 1. Renewal risk flagged: they mentioned strict latency SLAs in the contract.
Raj (Eng Lead): Noted re: SLA. We'll prepare a canary config and a degraded-mode fallback. Proposed high-level timeline:
```
Day 0-3: discovery + access prep
Day 4-10: env setup, onboarding data ingest, network validation
Day 11-20: integration, smoke tests, perf tuning (canary)
Day 21-30: enablement, runbook handoff, go/no-go decision
```
Maya (CS): I'll capture that in the intake doc and share with the customer. Also need to coordinate enablement for their support agents during week 4.
Jake (Solutions Eng): FYI firewall/network ask — customer network team must open 443 and 8443 and allow our egress CIDR 10.2.0.0/16. Also need a service account with read access to their S3 bucket.
Sophie (PM): Risks to call out: data-mapping delays, cert pinning on their side, and billing reconciliation (they want usage visibility in the first 14 days).
Maya (CS): I'll handle customer comms. Draft message I'm about to send to their tech lead: 
```
Hi Sam — quick list we need to unblock setup:
- VPN or peered VPC details + firewall owner contact
- Service account + S3 bucket ARN with sample files (s3://...)
- Expected QPS & payload size for peak testing
- Point of contact for cert/PKI questions
Thanks — Maya (Redwood CS)
```
OnboardBot: Reminder — add calendar invite for "NimbusEdge - Setup" within 24h or link the intake doc.
Maya (CS): I'll book two 60m sessions: 1) Infra walk-through, 2) Enablement for their L1. Proposed slots: Tue 2026-04-07 14:00 PT and Thu 2026-04-09 09:00 PT.
Jake (Solutions Eng): I can do Tue.
Raj (Eng Lead): Thu works for me to cover canary details.
Sophie (PM): I'll prepare the success evaluation checklist and a 50-sample prompt corpus for perf smoke.
Maya (CS): Action items recap: 
- Maya: send comms + book invites
- Jake: infra checklist + request S3 sample files
- Raj: canary config + perf knobs to try if latency > target
- Sophie: success evals + prompt corpus
I'll update the intake doc and ping everyone once invites are set. Thanks all :thumbsup:
